'''Thermal cutters''' were a handheld [[Beamdrill/Legends|beamdrill]] designed for cold-weather expeditions. Capable of projecting a heat beam that evaporated snow and cut through ice, the charge of a thermal cutter lasted five minutes on its own power, or indefinitely if plugged into a [[Fusion lantern/Legends|fusion lantern]].
